SELECT s.seshkey AS session_id,
       s.seshstart AS session_start,
       s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval / 100.0) AS sbra,
       AVG(i.seqval) AS avg_sequence_value,
       CASE WHEN s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval / 100.0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE AVG(i.seqval) / (s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval / 100.0)) END AS rtse
FROM sessions s
JOIN interactions i ON i.seshlink2 = s.seshkey
GROUP BY s.seshkey, s.seshstart, s.bncrate, s.ctrval

SELECT u.userkey AS user_id,
       s.seshclicks AS clicks,
       s.seshviews AS views,
       s.engscore AS engagement_score,
       (s.seshclicks + s.seshviews) * (s.engscore / 100.0) AS euim
FROM users u
JOIN sessions s ON s.userel = u.userkey
ORDER BY euim DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH base AS (
  SELECT date(seshstart) AS session_date,
         (seshviews * engscore) / seshdur AS uer
  FROM sessions
), withavg AS (
  SELECT session_date, uer,
         AVG(uer) OVER (PARTITION BY session_date) AS avg_daily_uer
  FROM base
)
SELECT session_date, uer, avg_daily_uer
FROM withavg
WHERE uer > avg_daily_uer
ORDER BY session_date

SELECT r.posval AS position,
       COUNT(r.reckey) AS total_recommendations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.evttype = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_clicks,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(r.reckey) > 0
            THEN 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.evttype = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(r.reckey)
            ELSE 0 END AS rctr
FROM recommendations r
LEFT JOIN interactions i ON i.reclink = r.reckey
GROUP BY r.posval
ORDER BY r.posval ASC

WITH u AS (
  SELECT substatus, gendlbl, occulbl,
         CASE WHEN ageval < 25 THEN 'Under 25'
              WHEN ageval BETWEEN 25 AND 34 THEN '25-34'
              WHEN ageval BETWEEN 35 AND 44 THEN '35-44'
              WHEN ageval BETWEEN 45 AND 54 THEN '45-54'
              ELSE '55+' END AS age_group,
         subdays * (CASE substatus WHEN 'Premium' THEN 2.0
                                   WHEN 'Enterprise' THEN 3.0
                                   WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.5 END) AS usv,
         ageval * (CASE WHEN gendlbl IN ('Male', 'Female') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.8 END)
                * (CASE occulbl WHEN 'Professional' THEN 1.5
                                WHEN 'Retired' THEN 1.2
                                WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.7
                                WHEN 'Other' THEN 1.0 ELSE 1.0 END) AS uds,
         CAST(json_extract(user_preferences, '$.satisfaction_score') AS REAL) AS satisfaction_score,
         json_extract(user_preferences, '$.interests') AS interests
  FROM users
)
SELECT substatus AS subscription_type,
       gendlbl AS gender,
       occulbl AS occupation,
       age_group,
       COUNT(*) AS user_count,
       ROUND(AVG(usv), 2) AS avg_usv,
       ROUND(AVG(uds), 2) AS avg_uds,
       ROUND(AVG(satisfaction_score), 2) AS avg_satisfaction_score,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT interests) AS shared_interests
FROM u
GROUP BY substatus, gendlbl, occulbl, age_group
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
ORDER BY avg_usv DESC, avg_uds DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', regmoment) AS registration_month,
       testgrp AS test_group,
       COUNT(*) AS total_registrations,
       100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y-%m', regmoment)) AS cohort_percentage
FROM users
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', regmoment), testgrp
ORDER BY registration_month, test_group

WITH m AS (
  SELECT artkey, catlabel,
         (qualscore + freshscore + sentscore - contrscore) / 3.0 AS aqi,
         (readsec * log(wordlen)) /
           (CASE difflevel WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1.0
                           WHEN 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
                           WHEN 'Advanced' THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.2 END) AS ars
  FROM articles
)
SELECT catlabel AS category,
       json_group_array(json_object('artkey', artkey, 'catlabel', catlabel, 'aqi', aqi, 'ars', ars)) AS articles
FROM m
GROUP BY catlabel

SELECT rectrace AS trace_id,
       resptime AS response_time,
       loadscore AS load_score,
       perfscore AS performance_score,
       (perfscore - loadscore) AS performance_delta,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY resptime DESC) AS response_time_rank,
       CASE WHEN resptime > 200 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN resptime > 150 THEN 'Warning'
            ELSE 'Normal' END AS performance_status
FROM systemperformance
WHERE resptime > 100

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.seshkey, s.userel, s.bncrate, s.ctrval, s.engscore, s.seshdur, s.seshviews,
         s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval / 100.0) AS adjusted_bounce_rate
  FROM sessions s
), pct AS (
  SELECT b.*,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY b.adjusted_bounce_rate) AS bounce_percentile,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY b.ctrval DESC) AS ctr_percentile
  FROM base b
), seg AS (
  SELECT p.*, u.typelabel, u.seglabel,
         CASE
           WHEN p.bounce_percentile < 0.25 AND p.ctr_percentile < 0.25 THEN 'High Bounce, Low CTR'
           WHEN p.bounce_percentile < 0.25 AND p.ctr_percentile >= 0.75 THEN 'High Bounce, High CTR'
           WHEN p.bounce_percentile >= 0.75 AND p.ctr_percentile < 0.25 THEN 'Low Bounce, Low CTR'
           WHEN p.bounce_percentile >= 0.75 AND p.ctr_percentile >= 0.75 THEN 'Low Bounce, High CTR'
           ELSE 'Average Performance'
         END AS performance_segment
  FROM pct p
  JOIN users u ON u.userkey = p.userel
)
SELECT typelabel AS user_type,
       seglabel AS user_segment,
       performance_segment,
       COUNT(*) AS session_count,
       ROUND(AVG(bncrate), 2) AS avg_bounce_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(adjusted_bounce_rate), 2) AS avg_adjusted_bounce_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(ctrval), 2) AS avg_ctr,
       ROUND(AVG(engscore), 2) AS avg_engagement_score,
       ROUND(AVG(seshdur), 2) AS avg_duration,
       ROUND(AVG(seshviews), 2) AS avg_page_views
FROM seg
GROUP BY typelabel, seglabel, performance_segment
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
ORDER BY avg_adjusted_bounce_rate, avg_ctr

WITH m AS (
  SELECT catlabel,
         (readsec * log(wordlen)) /
           (CASE difflevel WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1.0
                           WHEN 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
                           WHEN 'Advanced' THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.2 END) AS ars,
         CAST(json_extract(engagement_metrics, '$.engagement_rate') AS REAL) AS eng_rate
  FROM articles
)
SELECT catlabel AS category,
       AVG(ars) AS avg_readability_score,
       AVG(eng_rate) AS avg_engagement_rate,
       (AVG(ars * eng_rate) - AVG(ars) * AVG(eng_rate)) /
         (SQRT(AVG(ars * ars) - AVG(ars) * AVG(ars)) * SQRT(AVG(eng_rate * eng_rate) - AVG(eng_rate) * AVG(eng_rate)))
         AS correlation_coefficient,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ars < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_readability_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ars >= 50 AND ars <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium_readability_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ars > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_readability_count
FROM m
GROUP BY catlabel
